ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.
   C. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.

   D. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
